title: LeanVM
description:
Post-Quantum Ethereum. Think:
- Aggregating PQ consensus signatures (XMSS).
- Aggregating PQ user signatures (sphincs based).
- PQ Data Availability (Merkle Tree over Reed-Solomon encoding).
... via a minimal zkVM.

Single cryptographic assumption: secure hash function.
Binary fields magic. Standard hash. 128 bits provable security.
